FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
NAAC A++ Accredited
Hazratbal, Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir - 190006, India
Notice
It has been observed that majority of the candidates who have applied for the post of Public
Relations Officer (PRO) in response to Advertisement Notice No. 01 of 2026 dated 01-01-
2026 have not uploaded the requisite documents in support of their eligibility.
Accordingly, all such applicants who have already submitted their application forms under the
aforesaid advertisement are advised to upload/update the required supporting documents in
their recruitment portal accounts on or before 22-01-2026, and thereafter submit the form.
Applicants are also advised to ensure that the prescribed application fee, has been paid.
Further, candidates are advised to visit the University website regularly, in their own interest, for
updates.
By Order,
Sd/-
No: F(01 of 2026) /KU/Rect/2026 Deputy Registrar
Dated: 08/ 01/ 2026 (Recruitment)
